author: Claire Lewis
description:
Last month's Nintendo Direct was full of all types of treats for Kingdom Hearts fans, including the announcement that native versions of the entire Kingdom Hearts trilogy will be coming to Switch 2 via the release of The Kingdom Hearts Collection [I-III]. Unfortunately, players did not respond well to the trilogy's key art, which Square Enix shared on X shortly after the announcement. Players quickly noticed several strange details in the image, and accused Square Enix of using generative AI to create it.

GameSpot immediately
title: Exclusive: Disney Insists That Cursed Kingdom Hearts Art Was Not AI-Generated

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Diablo 4 Season 15 will receive a new character Rebirth feature--one that will allow players to convert Eternal Realm characters into seasonal ones.

Usually, it goes the opposite way. Characters at the end of a season are automatically converted into non-seasonal Eternal Realm ones, where they typically languish in neglect until they need to be deleted to make room for new seasonal characters. 

As part of the newly detailed Season 15, developer Blizzard will instead let players continue to play the same character by using the Rebirth function to transfer Eternal Realm characters to the seasonal realm. That character's level will be reset to level one, but their total playtime will remain intact, as will their class, name, a
title: Diablo 4 Will Finally Let You Play The Same Character Each Season

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Diablo 4's next season will see the return of some of the most iconic items from throughout the franchise's history, including powerful rings like Stone of Jordan and Ring of Royal Grandeur.

The currently ongoing Season 14 hasn't exactly been Diablo 4's best season, but Blizzard is looking to give players an early preview of what's coming in Season 15 with a playable public-test realm build available August 4-11.

As detailed in an official blog post, it's a season that looks to introduce several new systems and changes. First and foremost is the arrival of fan-favorite items from previous Diablo games as Uniques. Blizzard announced a total of 10 items returning from the original Diablo, Diablo 2, and Diablo 3, and they are
title: Diablo 4 Season 15 Is Adding Stone Of Jordan And Other Iconic Items From Diablo’s Past

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Helldivers 2 players will soon be able to dish out death to Super Earth enemies with Warhammer 40K weapons like the Meltagun, Bolt Pistol, and more.

Games Workshop's grimdark Warhammer 40K universe is the next crossover coming to developer Arrowhead Studios' popular shooter on August 12 in the form of a Legendary Warbond, joining the likes of Halo and Killzone. While there are none of the setting's iconic Space Marines in sight, 40K's Astra Militarum faction is instead getting the spotlight.

As revealed in a new trailer, two Astra Militarum-inspired armor sets are coming to Helldivers 2. One, the Demo Trooper, is a heavy-armor set, while the other, the Sharpshooter, is a medium-arm
title: Helldivers 2’s Long-Awaited Warhammer 40K Warbond Brings Grimdark New Weapons, Though Not The Most Iconic

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The gig economy comes for us all in the end, and if you've ever worked a few Uber shifts, you'll be well aware how some customers are a bit… odd. That's the vibe that Rideshare Stimulator--no, that is not a typo, and the game title is stylized as Rideshare "Stimulator" for some reason, but we're not doing that--is attempting to capture.

Like the many, many simulator games on the market, Rideshare Stimulator is aiming to authentically replicate what it's like to be a rideshare driver in the age of late-stage capitalism, making it look like Crazy Taxi without any of the over-the-top action of ferrying people about--and you'll have to boot up Spotify if you want to hear The Offspring during your digita
title: Rideshare “Stimulator” Is Basically An Uber Simulator With Weirder Passengers

author: Levi Winslow
description:
Despite losing a staggering amount of staff in a recent layoff, developer ZeniMax Online Studios (ZOS) has reiterated that The Elder Scrolls Online (ESO) is "here to stay," and the team has dropped a new roadmap to prove that more content is still coming to the popular MMORPG.

In a July 30 news post on ESO's official website, game director Nick Giacomini outlined what you can expect from the MMORPG in 2026 and 2027. Many of the most anticipated changes, such as the combat and class refresh and Update 52, have been pushed to next year to focus on "quality experiences over calendar dates."
title: After Layoffs, New Elder Scrolls Online Content Is Delayed But Still Coming

author: S.E. Doster
description:
The first two Call of Duty: Black Ops games recently launched on PS5 and PS4 as ports of the original games, and hackers haven't wasted any time ruining the nostalgia. Players are reporting that Black Ops 2 is currently not safe from a specific hacker or possibly group of hackers, who are resetting player accounts or changing specific settings.

Hackers are notoriously present in Call of Duty games, especially in the older titles, but this is the more intrusive variety than just the cheaters with aimbot and wallhacks. Players are reporting several issues after encountering player accounts called "C Isn't Sharp" and "Who Isn't Sharp."

Players claim their encounter with these specific gamertags in Black Ops 2 lobbies are causing them to be kicked out of matches, having their rank change, and altered weapon classes. Other more extreme reports claim their account was completely reset or
title: CoD: Black Ops 2 Port Is Plagued By A Hacker Resetting Accounts

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Dead by Daylight's next chapter, Chorus of Sin, is a "community-driven" event that kicks off at the end of August, but you can start playing it up to a month early by winning yourself an early-access code. 

Starting July 30, Dead by Daylight content creators will stream the new Chorus of Sin chapter on Twitch, and tuning in for at least an hour will place you in a drawing that will randomly select winners. Those lucky players will receive Steam codes via email to play the next chapter ahead of its August 25 public date. It'll even get you in before the private test build launches on August 5.

The early-access windows will be limited and spread across the next several days. You can find that schedule below.

  • Thursday, July 30: 12-4 PM ET and 5-9 PM ET
title: Dead By Daylight Is Giving Out Free Codes For Its Next Chapter

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: This year marks several big video game anniversaries, from the 25th anniversary of Halo to the Super NES turning 35, and publisher Bethesda Softworks is celebrating 40 years in the industry with a brand-new logo. The company unveiled the new design today, which has a very cyberpunk-inspired look to it with its choice of font, colors, and subtle decorative elements. "40 years of adventures. Here's to the worlds we've built together... and those still to come. We're marking the occasion with a logo inspired by our roots," Bethesda wrote online.
title: Bethesda’s New Logo Looks Like It Actually Belongs To A Video Game Company

author: Levi Winslow
description:
The biggest topic in the games industry right now is the debate around physical media, with Sony kickstarting the conversation by killing its production of PlayStation discs in January 2028. Everyone has thoughts about the company's decision, including Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi, who said he's trying to make a physical edition of the game happen.

In a July 29 interview with GamesRadar+, Hamaguchi acknowledged that "the general trend" he's seeing is a shift to
title: FF7 Revelation Director Really Wants You To Have A Physical Edition For The Game

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: It's a good time to be a fan of video game movies based on Capcom's IP, as both live-action Resident Evil and Street Fighter films are on the way. While we've seen plenty of director Zach Cregger's spin on the survival-horror series, Street Fighter has been mostly radio silent since its last trailer dropped--until today, that is. A new preview for the movie just dropped, showcasing an electrifying tussl
title: The New Street Fighter Movie Teaser Brings Blanka’s Electric Attacks To Life

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The last couple of months have been grim for Xbox, and to add to its woes, Microsoft's gaming division experienced a massive $1.7 billion decline in revenue last quarter. At the same time, Microsoft reported that profits had increased substantially during the same April to June period, reaching $35.8 billion in profit thanks to its AI and cloud initiatives.

In its fourth-quarter earnings report, Microsoft said that Xbox revenue decreased by 7%--around $1.7 billion--and it attributed the losses to a decline in Xbox hardware, services, and content. Looking specifically at hardware, revenue from this part of the Xbox business decreased by 29%, due to fewer consoles being sold--likely due in part to
title: Xbox Was Microsoft’s Biggest Weak Spot Last Quarter

author: Ben Janca
description:
For whom the bell tolls, it tolls for thee.

Whether you are holding the line in Horde Siege, or honing your skills in Versus, E-Day offers a brand-new way to experience the intensity, combat, and unique camaraderie that Gears of War is known for. Its time grab your favorite Gears character, squad up and join the fight!

Pre-order Gears of War: E-Day for Early Access to the Open Beta, starting August 6th.
title: Gears of War: E-Day – Official Multiplayer Gameplay Reveal Trailer

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Gears of War started out as an Epic Games-developed title, but the franchise has been in the experienced hands of The Coalition for over a decade. With Gears of War: E-Day dropping in October, the studio is aiming to bring the franchise back with a bang after a lengthy hiatus. We recently went hands-on with the game--you can check out the video preview below--and our immediate takeaway was that The Coalition hasn't skipped a beat as it still knows how to put together a Gears game that looks and feels great.

Set during the cataclysmic events of Emergence Day, Gears of War: E-Day tells the story of humanity's first encounter with the Locust. Outgunned and caught by surprise, it's up to Marcus Fenix to rally the survivors and turn the tide of the conflict. While we didn't get to experience the campaign,
title: Gears Of War: E-Day Is Shaping Up To Be Exactly The Comeback Gears Needed

author: Richard Li
description: My time with E-Day's Technical Test was a good reminder that The Coalition are masters at making a great feeling Gears of War game.
title: E-Day Is The Best Gears Has Ever Felt | Horde and Versus Hands-On Impression

author: Callum Self
description:
For all of Borderlands 3's issues, that familiar looter-shooter gameplay remained as brilliant as ever. While the narrative lacked, especially compared to Borderlands 2, the third mainline entry refined the gunplay and added to the series' signature chaos. Borderlands 4 builds on all of that. The story and its themes are treated with more maturity while still leaving plenty of room for slapstick humor and the absurd. And yes, there are still more guns than you could ever hope to loot. So, if you've been waiting to play it, now's your best chance to grab it at a discount, but only if you're quick.

Few games nail the looter layer on top of great FPS gameplay, but Gearbox Software has managed to do exactly that with Borderlands 4. This time, you and your crew of Vault Hunters travel across the prison planet of Kairos in an effort to stop the tyrannical Timekeeper
title: Borderlands 4 Is At Its Lowest Price, But Only For One More Day
